description: The chevron that opens and closes a row or a panel, with the rotation and the aria-expanded wiring already done. Copy: the label names what opens, not the direction — "Show the transcript", not "Expand".

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon shown always (collapsed and expanded state).

props.name: label
props.description: Label shown when expanded (hover or active).

props.name: withChevron
props.description: Show a chevron indicating dropdown / disclosure.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Force expanded state (for use inside open dropdowns).
